{{Short description|Danish chemist and criminal}}
'''Allan Steen Kristensen''' (1958 – 1997) was a Danish person who, as a 19-year-old student, placed nine [[pipe bomb]]s in and around [[Copenhagen]] in 1977–1978. He was nicknamed the 'Bomb Man from [[Gladsaxe]]' (''Bombemanden fra Gladsaxe'') and 'Mystical X' (''Det mystiske X'').<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://bt.dk/sites/default/files-dk/node-files/915/4/4915619-kwa_bombeterror2.swf |title=Archived copy |access-date=2018-07-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140904201221/http://www.bt.dk/sites/default/files-dk/node-files/915/4/4915619-kwa_bombeterror2.swf |archive-date=2014-09-04 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Of his nine bombs, five detonated. Four people were injured from the blasts, including himself, though no-one was killed. The bomb streak created fear among local residents, which were further bolstered by numerous phone and letter threats.<ref name="altomhistorie.dk">{{cite web|url=https://altomhistorie.dk/kriminalitet/kriminelle/bombemanden-fra-gladsaxe|title=Bombemanden fra Gladsaxe|date=7 November 2012|website=altomhistorie.dk|access-date=2018-07-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180721162305/https://altomhistorie.dk/kriminalitet/kriminelle/bombemanden-fra-gladsaxe|archive-date=2018-07-21|url-status=live}}</ref>

Kristensen placed his first bomb in [[Søborg]] on 4 August 1977. The most spectacular location of one of his bombs was in a sandbox at a school in Gladsaxe on 11 November 1977. The bomb was buried in the sand and connected to a toy, which was discovered by a child. It did not go off  because its battery fell out of the assembly.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://politiken.dk/indland/article502473.ece|title=Bombemanden terroriserede danskerne|website=politiken.dk|date=May 2008 |access-date=2018-07-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080502005602/http://politiken.dk/indland/article502473.ece|archive-date=2008-05-02|url-status=live}}</ref>

At a [[communist]] rally on 1 May 1978 in [[Fælledparken]], a bomb went off between Kristensen's hands, causing him to lose three fingers on his right hand. He was then arrested. During his trial he claimed that he had no political motives.<ref name="altomhistorie.dk"/> Doctors described him as intelligent and with no mental issues.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.b.dk/kultur/til-minde-om-folkets-glemte-taleroer|title=Til minde om folkets glemte talerør|date=2 August 2006|website=b.dk|access-date=2018-07-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180721162429/https://www.b.dk/kultur/til-minde-om-folkets-glemte-taleroer|archive-date=2018-07-21|url-status=live}}</ref> On 16 March 1979, Kristensen was sentenced to five years in prison. He was released on probation in September 1981, later graduated as a [[chemist]] and got married.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ptt-museum.dk/museumsposten/tidligere_artikler/telefoni/?id=322|title=Telefoni - Enigma - Museum for post, tele og kommunikation|website=ptt-museum.dk|access-date=2018-07-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180721162539/http://www.ptt-museum.dk/museumsposten/tidligere_artikler/telefoni/?id=322|archive-date=2018-07-21|url-status=live}}</ref>

Allan Steen Kristensen died from heart problems in 1997, at the age of 38.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://altomhistorie.dk/artikler/bombemanden-fra-gladsaxe/|title=Bombemanden fra Gladsaxe|date=7 November 2012|website=altomhistorie.dk|access-date=2018-07-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180327043326/http://altomhistorie.dk/artikler/bombemanden-fra-gladsaxe|archive-date=2018-03-27|url-status=live}}</ref>
